# SHA-256 of every migration that has shipped on main, one 'version checksum' per line.
# A deployed server refuses to boot when an applied migration's checksum changes, so these
# files are immutable: change the schema in a NEW migration. The PR that adds a migration
# appends its line here; ShippedMigrationChecksumTest fails until it does.
